# data source: thoth_governance_evidence_slos

```terraform
data "thoth_governance_evidence_slos" "current" {
  window_hours = 24
  scan_limit   = 20000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scan_limit` (Number) Maximum behavioral event rows to scan.
- `window_hours` (Number) Trailing window in hours.

### Read-Only

- `decision_reason_code_coverage` (Number) Coverage ratio for decision_reason_code population.
- `decision_to_api_visibility_latency_p95_seconds` (Number) P95 decision-to-API visibility latency in seconds.
- `deepllm_enrichment_join_rate` (Number) Coverage ratio for DeepLLM enrichment joins by enforcement trace ID.
- `evidence_chain_verification_success` (Number) Coverage ratio for chain verification fields on candidate rows.
- `failures_json` (String) Failure identifiers as a JSON array when thresholds do not pass.
- `generated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp for report generation.
- `metrics_json` (String) Raw SLO metrics object as JSON.
- `passed` (Boolean) True when all evidence SLO thresholds pass.
- `policy_reference_coverage_non_allow` (Number) Coverage ratio for policy references on non-ALLOW decisions.
- `rows_scanned` (Number) Behavioral event rows scanned.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID in the computed SLO report.
- `thresholds_json` (String) SLO thresholds as a JSON object.
- `violation_id_presence_rate` (Number) Coverage ratio for violation ID presence on relevant rows.
- `violation_relevant_rows` (Number) Rows considered relevant for violation-id presence coverage.
